fixture_kind: Paper-corroborated fixed-input temporal regression baseline; not an independently published numerical oracle
scope: RX Benchmark; Full Range | All Directions; max_peer_distance_km=10000; minimum joint spots per station=1; all solar states; legacy_no_code historical selection; pooled native same-cycle paired observations

paper_anchor.quote: On average there are some 2,000 spots each day
paper_anchor.interpretation: Context suggests paired same-transmitter/same-time comparisons. Approximate corroboration only; no justified numerical acceptance interval is specified by the paper. Blue squares are soil moisture on right axis.

expected_value_method: Extract both-SNR component rows from frozen processed results, independently subtract and sort; calculate bins, medians, means and linear quartiles with standard-library arithmetic, then cross-check current production canonical evidence and temporal functions. Expected values remain a reviewed implementation baseline corroborated by paper, not author-supplied measurements.
regression_policy: Freeze expected files. Exact equality for identities, counts and integer/quarter-dB values in this dataset; absolute tolerance1e-12dB for floating arithmetic summaries. Never regenerate expectations automatically during tests. Deliberate scientific method changes require a reviewed baseline update.
deferred: The installed regression module replays input_sql_rows.parquet through production post-fetch filtering, station aggregation, paired-evidence extraction and temporal profiles. SQL execution, provider selection, automatic fallback and upstream power normalization remain outside this test. Original source rows are retained for a later SQL-level test.
